stem: A spill occurs during batch preparation. What should guide the response?
choices: Continue mixing so the batch does not time out.
Neutralize it with another chemical from memory.
Rinse everything immediately regardless of product hazards.
The facility spill/exposure procedure and product hazard information, using required PPE and escalation.
rationale: The facility spill/exposure procedure and product hazard information, using required PPE and escalation.
